issue.title: tui_perf.md rule 14 still conditions token refresh on the retired ace_refresh_tokens flag

task_type_fields.proposed_change: Epic sase-1jc retired the `ace_refresh_tokens` sunset flag; token-based refresh is now unconditional. Rule 14 in `sase/memory/tui_perf.md` ("Idle ticks skip unchanged surfaces.") still opens "With `ace_refresh_tokens` on (the default), auto-refresh probes stat-only change tokens...". Remove the flag condition so the rule reads that auto-refresh always probes stat-only change tokens and reloads only drifted surfaces. Preserve the rest of the rule verbatim: do not restore `not watcher_active => reload everything`, the `refresh.auto_tick` span counters (`surfaces_reloaded`, `surfaces`, `axe_file_opens`), the `axe.collect` `file_opens` events under `SASE_TUI_TRACE=1`, and the quiet-tick expectation. Republish with `sase memory init`.

issue.creation_reason: Every sase-1jc phase recorded this PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP because the epic's auto decision refresh_memory=no forbade editing tui_perf.md without human review; the land agent files it so a human can approve the one-sentence fix.
